activity_summary: Anne said you had come, and that you had said Friday in a letter. Your mother said you are thin. Your father asked the horse who he was. The sword went to Hamnet, three colours of ribbon to Judith, the riddle-book to Susanna, who thanked you and opened it. You had no speech to put on the day. The gifts came out separately, and the quarrel did not.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered the door, gave the gifts, and kept the speech unsaid.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Met him with the flour still on her arms, and named the letter.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Said he was thin, and moved the wet away from the bread.

entities.name: John Shakespeare
entities.context: Addressed the horse, and refused him as a customer.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Thanked him, and opened the riddle-book at the stair.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the lath, and began on the hilt.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the ribbons, and declined a share of the sword.

facets.activity: Gave out the gifts at the door

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: You said it in a letter.

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: You're thin. They don't feed players, then.
